claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Carmofur is a 5-fluorouracil prodrug that releases 5-FU, which inhibits thymidylate synthase and is incorporated into RNA/DNA, causing DNA synthesis inhibition and S-phase cytotoxicity; at 2.5 uM over 5 days this antimetabolite effect is the dominant killing mechanism, with acid ceramidase inhibition and Mpro inhibition being unlikely to drive broad anticancer cell killing at this concentration.
